items.q: Nicky, she had her father's car, and we brought the records so I told her to go eat lunch while I (inaudible) took them on in, and I unloaded all the records and she got impatient and she came over

ctx.x: How did Wax Records come about?
Nicky Peters, a very beautiful lady, maybe I don't want to put this on record.
Well, then, tell it the way you want to tell it.
